summary: Separate local Cart, HBNF endpoint, scoring-cloud, source freshness, Matrix live-snapshot, and command acknowledgement evidence in the Owner PWA.

scoped_evidence.affected_subsystem: Existing Cart Owner PWA network/readiness and Matrix live-standings feedback.
scoped_evidence.observed_source_defect: A score-cloud response does not establish access from this iPad to the HBNF public endpoint. The UI lacked an independent endpoint check and could not distinguish an unattempted check from a failed or timed-out check. Matrix source revision could also appear aligned after its 120-second live lease had expired.
scoped_evidence.implementation: Load the already-declared small HBNF cart icon with a cache-busting URL, a four-second timeout and a one-minute throttle. Only successful image load reports endpoint reachability from this iPad; errors and timeouts remain unverified. Keep scoring-cloud status independent and require the Matrix live lease before describing revision alignment.
scoped_evidence.rollback_reference: Revert the isolated source change; no device, cloud, router, firmware, release or scoring mutation is included.
